title: :AcreView in another buffer switches the open viewer to it
body:
The neovim plugin keeps at most one viewer (`view` in `editors/nvim/lua/acre/init.lua`). `M.toggle` closes it whenever one is open, so `:AcreView` in a second `.acre` buffer closes the viewer instead of showing that buffer.

## Proposal

`:AcreView` in the buffer the viewer shows closes it, as now. In any other buffer it moves the link there: the autocmds follow the new buffer, the old buffer's diagnostics clear, and the new buffer's text, path and cursor go to the running viewer, in the same window. acre-gui pauses at 0 when the path in a `text` message differs from the last one, as it does when it opens a file. Jack chose this over finding other viewers to reuse (by file, focus or workspace), which would need a socket per viewer and covers little more.
